title: GenAI Hub - Token Economics and Chargeback
description: Live token consumption and chargeback across every model family, built on the product / consumer / model / region dimensions carried in AppMetrics. Denominated in tokens: an editable rate card in the Rate Card section turns on cost without guessing prices.

list.name: product
list.label: Product
list.description: Filter the dashboard to one or more APIM products.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppMetrics
| where Name in ('Prompt Tokens', 'Completion Tokens')
| extend P = todynamic(Properties)
| extend Product = tostring(P['Product ID']), Consumer = tostring(P['Subscription ID']),
         Model = tostring(P['Model']), Region = tostring(P['Region']), Api = tostring(P['API ID'])
| where isnotempty(Model)
| distinct Product
| where isnotempty(Product)
| order by Product asc

list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.description: Filter the dashboard to one or more model deployments.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppMetrics
| where Name in ('Prompt Tokens', 'Completion Tokens')
| extend P = todynamic(Properties)
| extend Product = tostring(P['Product ID']), Consumer = tostring(P['Subscription ID']),
         Model = tostring(P['Model']), Region = tostring(P['Region']), Api = tostring(P['API ID'])
| where isnotempty(Model)
| distinct Model
| order by Model asc

panels.title: Total Tokens
panels.description: All prompt and completion tokens through the model gateway in the selected window, across every model family.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppMetrics
| where Name in ('Prompt Tokens', 'Completion Tokens')
| extend P = todynamic(Properties)
| extend Product = tostring(P['Product ID']), Consumer = tostring(P['Subscription ID']),
         Model = tostring(P['Model']), Region = tostring(P['Region']), Api = tostring(P['API ID'])
| where isnotempty(Model)
| where '*' in (${product:singlequote}) or Product in (${product:singlequote})
| where '*' in (${model:singlequote}) or Model in (${model:singlequote})
| summarize Tokens=sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Prompt Tokens
panels.description: Input tokens. Usually the cheaper half of the bill, but the larger volume.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppMetrics
| where Name in ('Prompt Tokens', 'Completion Tokens')
| extend P = todynamic(Properties)
| extend Product = tostring(P['Product ID']), Consumer = tostring(P['Subscription ID']),
         Model = tostring(P['Model']), Region = tostring(P['Region']), Api = tostring(P['API ID'])
| where isnotempty(Model)
| where '*' in (${product:singlequote}) or Product in (${product:singlequote})
| where '*' in (${model:singlequote}) or Model in (${model:singlequote})
| where Name == 'Prompt Tokens'
| summarize Tokens=sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Completion Tokens
panels.description: Generated tokens. Typically priced several times higher than input, so this drives cost far more than its volume suggests.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppMetrics
| where Name in ('Prompt Tokens', 'Completion Tokens')
| extend P = todynamic(Properties)
| extend Product = tostring(P['Product ID']), Consumer = tostring(P['Subscription ID']),
         Model = tostring(P['Model']), Region = tostring(P['Region']), Api = tostring(P['API ID'])
| where isnotempty(Model)
| where '*' in (${product:singlequote}) or Product in (${product:singlequote})
| where '*' in (${model:singlequote}) or Model in (${model:singlequote})
| where Name == 'Completion Tokens'
| summarize Tokens=sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)

panels.title: Output Share
panels.description: Completion tokens as a percentage of total. The single best cost predictor available without prices: a rising share means spend grows faster than volume.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppMetrics
| where Name in ('Prompt Tokens', 'Completion Tokens')
| extend P = todynamic(Properties)
| extend Product = tostring(P['Product ID']), Consumer = tostring(P['Subscription ID']),
         Model = tostring(P['Model']), Region = tostring(P['Region']), Api = tostring(P['API ID'])
| where isnotempty(Model)
| where '*' in (${product:singlequote}) or Product in (${product:singlequote})
| where '*' in (${model:singlequote}) or Model in (${model:singlequote})
| summarize Prompt=sumif(Sum, Name=='Prompt Tokens'), Completion=sumif(Sum, Name=='Completion Tokens') by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| project TimeGenerated, OutputShare = 100.0 * Completion / iff(Prompt+Completion == 0, 1.0, Prompt+Completion)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Product Chargeback Detail
panels.description: Per-product allocation basis. APM ID is parsed from the product name where present. Output share flags products whose usage skews to expensive generated tokens.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppMetrics
| where Name in ('Prompt Tokens', 'Completion Tokens')
| extend P = todynamic(Properties)
| extend Product = tostring(P['Product ID']), Consumer = tostring(P['Subscription ID']),
         Model = tostring(P['Model']), Region = tostring(P['Region']), Api = tostring(P['API ID'])
| where isnotempty(Model)
| where '*' in (${product:singlequote}) or Product in (${product:singlequote})
| where '*' in (${model:singlequote}) or Model in (${model:singlequote})
| summarize Prompt=sumif(Sum, Name=='Prompt Tokens'), Completion=sumif(Sum, Name=='Completion Tokens'),
            Models=dcount(Model), Consumers=dcount(Consumer) by Product
| extend Total = Prompt + Completion
| extend ['Output %'] = round(100.0 * Completion / iff(Total==0, 1.0, Total), 2)
| extend ['APM ID'] = extract(@'([0-9]{5,6})', 1, Product)
| extend ['Share %'] = round(100.0 * Total / toscalar(
      AppMetrics | where Name in ('Prompt Tokens','Completion Tokens') | summarize sum(Sum)), 2)
| project Product, ['APM ID'], Total, Prompt, Completion, ['Output %'], ['Share %'], Models, Consumers
| order by Total desc

panels.title: Model Consumption Detail

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppMetrics

         Model = tostring(P['Model']), Region = tostring(P['Region']), Api = tostring(P['API ID'])

options.content:
### Rates are real. Coverage is not complete.

Rates below are **derived from actual Azure billing** (Cost Management, Jul 2026), in **EUR per 1M tokens**, split input/output.

### What is missing

These panels are built on `AppMetrics`, which **does not carry any Anthropic/Claude model**. Claude was about **EUR 36k of EUR 66k actual model spend in July** - so cost here covers OpenAI, Kimi and embeddings **only**.

Validated against billing for 1-30 Jul:

| | EUR |
|---|---|
| Estimated here | 12,502 |
| Actual (all models) | 66,022 |
| Actual (excl. Claude) | ~30,000 |

The remaining gap after Claude is **long-context and cache-write meters**, which are billed at premium rates this model does not represent.

### Why Claude cannot simply be added

`GatewayLlmLogs` is the only log source with Claude tokens and it is **incomplete**: over 30 days it reports 472M prompt tokens and **zero** completion and **zero** cached tokens, while billing shows billions of cache-hit tokens. It is not reliable for costing.

**Treat these figures as a directional lower bound for OpenAI-family models, not a bill.**
Azure Cost Management remains the source of truth.

panels.title: Estimated Cost by Product
panels.description: Cost per product using rates derived from actual Azure billing. EXCLUDES all Claude models (AppMetrics carries no Anthropic data) and does not model long-context or cache-write premiums, so totals run well below the real bill. Directional only.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
// ===================================================================
// RATE CARD - EUR per 1,000,000 tokens
// DERIVED FROM ACTUAL AZURE BILLING (Cost Management, Jul 2026).
// Each rate = billed cost / billed quantity for that model's meters.
// Meters quoted per 1K tokens were normalised to per 1M.
// These are effective actual rates, not list prices. Re-derive when
// your commercial terms change. Models showing 0.0 had no billable
// meter in the period - their cost will read 0 and 'Rate set' = no.
// ===================================================================
let Currency = 'EUR';
let Rates = datatable(Model:string, InPer1M:real, OutPer1M:real)[
    "gpt-5.4_gb_2026-03-05", 1.5577, 9.3462,
    "text-embedding-3-large_rg-swc_3", 0.1, 0.0,
    "gpt-5.4-mini_gb_2026-03-17", 0.4673, 2.8039,
    "gpt-5.4-nano_gb_2026-03-17", 0.1246, 0.7789,
    "gpt-41_dz-eu_2025-04-14", 1.4, 5.5,
    "gpt-5.2_gb_2025-12-11", 1.0904, 8.7231,
    "gpt-41_gb_2025-04-14", 1.2, 5.0,
    "gpt-4o-mini_dz-eu_2024-07-08", 0.1, 0.4,
    "gpt-5_dz-swc_2025-08-07", 0.8567, 6.8539,
    "gpt-5.1_dz-eu_2025-11-13", 0.8567, 6.8539,
    "text-embedding-ada-002_rg-euw_002", 0.1, 0.0,
    "gpt-41-mini_gb_2025-04-14", 0.2, 1.0,
    "gpt-5-nano_gb_2025-08-07", 0.0312, 0.2492,
    "Kimi-K2.6_gb_2026-04-20", 0.6, 2.5,
    "gpt-4o_dz-eu_2024-08-06", 1.7, 6.9,
    "gpt-5-mini_dz-swc_2025-08-07", 0.1713, 1.3708,
    "gpt-5.2-chat_gb_2025-12-11", 1.0904, 8.7231,
    "gpt-41-nano_dz-eu_2025-04-14", 0.1, 0.3,
    "model-router_gb_2025-11-18", 1.5577, 9.3462,
    "text-embedding-3-small_dz-eu_1", 0.1, 0.0,
    "gpt-5-nano_dz-swc_2025-08-07", 0.0343, 0.2742,
    "o1_dz-eu_2024-12-17", 10.3, 41.1,
    "text-embedding-ada-002_rg-swc_002", 0.1, 0.0,
    "o3-mini_dz-eu_2025-01-31", 0.8, 3.0,
    "gpt-5-mini_gb_2025-08-07", 0.1558, 1.2462,
    "gpt-5.6-terra_gb_2026-07-09", 1.5577, 9.3462,
    "gpt-5-chat_gb_2025-08-07", 1.0904, 8.7231,
    "gpt-5.6-luna_gb_2026-07-09", 0.6231, 3.7385,
    "gpt-5.6-sol_gb_2026-07-09", 3.1154, 18.6924,
    "model-router_dz-eu_2025-08-07", 1.5577, 9.3462,
    "gpt-41-nano_gb_2025-04-14", 1.2, 5.0,
    "qwen3-coder-next", 0.0, 0.0,
    "o4-mini_dz-eu_2025-04-16", 0.0, 0.0,
    "o4-mini_gb_2025-04-16", 0.0, 0.0,
    "gpt-5-codex_gb_2025-09-15", 0.0, 0.0,
    "mistral-small-rg-swc-2503", 0.0, 0.0,
    "granite-4.0-h-small", 0.0, 0.0
];
AppMetrics
| where Name in ('Prompt Tokens', 'Completion Tokens')
| extend P = todynamic(Properties)
| extend Product = tostring(P['Product ID']), Consumer = tostring(P['Subscription ID']),
         Model = tostring(P['Model']), Region = tostring(P['Region']), Api = tostring(P['API ID'])
| where isnotempty(Model)
| where '*' in (${product:singlequote}) or Product in (${product:singlequote})
| where '*' in (${model:singlequote}) or Model in (${model:singlequote})
| summarize Prompt=sumif(Sum, Name=='Prompt Tokens'), Completion=sumif(Sum, Name=='Completion Tokens') by Product, Model
| join kind=leftouter Rates on Model
| extend InPer1M = todouble(coalesce(InPer1M, 0.0)), OutPer1M = todouble(coalesce(OutPer1M, 0.0))
| extend ['Input cost'] = Prompt / 1000000.0 * InPer1M,
         ['Output cost'] = Completion / 1000000.0 * OutPer1M
| summarize ['Input cost']=round(sum(['Input cost']), 2), ['Output cost']=round(sum(['Output cost']), 2),
            Tokens=sum(Prompt+Completion) by Product
| extend ['Total cost'] = round(['Input cost'] + ['Output cost'], 2)
| project Product, ['Total cost'], ['Input cost'], ['Output cost'], Tokens
| order by ['Total cost'] desc, Tokens desc
